scope: Native V7 RTV3 host Unicorn/Mesa redraw of captured synthetic tool-0 turn-9.5 geometry; standalone SVG/PDF construction is not public export or device parity.
notes: resvg uses manually constructed rounded-rectangle vector, MuPDF renders PDF produced by converting that SVG. Both use 1px per document unit and same target. Alpha L1 over entire frame.
recipe: Run tools/marker4_v7/mesa_capture.py --capture-output /tmp/m4v7-stroke30.json using the PYTHONPATH in its docstring, then .venv/bin/python tools/marker4_v7/vector_comparison.py. The capture writes the requested JSON and sibling RGBA and mask files.
